<function name="rshift" parent="bit" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>
		Returns the right shifted value.
		<note>The returned value will be clamped to a signed 32-bit integer, even on 64-bit builds.</note>
	</description>
	<realm>Shared and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="value" type="number">The value to be manipulated.</arg>
		<arg name="shiftCount" type="number">Amounts of bits to shift right by.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">The shifted value.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
